Name: Joja Bus
Author: Jayzee37
Description:
Isn't it strange that once you get the community upgrades from Joja, [b]NOTHING[/b] ever changes? You can do the whole Joja upgrades, and the only thing
that trully changes at the end is the ending scene for the whole
community upgrades..

Well, now it does... sort of. In a small way, I guess.


Introducing: the Joja Bus.

Now, once you fork over all your funds to Morris to have him and his goons
repair the bus, they leave a small present, to make it clear it was JOJA
the one that made that [s]half-assed[/s] repair job.

Also, the ticket machine. Why? They had some leftover paint, and they didn't want to store half-empty cans of [s]lead[/s] paint, because it makes them all WOOZY.

What does it do? Well, it recolors the bus in blue, simple enough. Once you
get the community upgrade from Joja, next morning, voila! The bus is
blue!


Also, I've added an interior. Full disclosure, it's simply the bus interior from the cut introduction of the game.

I took inspiration on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3153665]UlithiumDragon[/url]'s restoration, adding my own recolor of the interior. Now, it looks almost identical to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1032]Bus Interior Restored[color=#ffffff], however, [/color][/url]I've reworked the interior to avoid MOST visual glitches, along with a couple of small tweaks.﻿


[size=3][b]Note: [/b][/size]

The recolor will appear only AFTER the Community Upgrade. You know, because
that's the whole point. The interior appears as soon as you install the
mod, and changes depending on the type of upgrade.

Also, this will most definitely conflict with any mod that recolors the bus, or
more specifically, anything that modifies the tilesheet. This should
work fine with mods that modify the bus stop, but beware of any mod that
edits the bus location at the Bus Stop. I've added an option to disable
it, just in case.
